tour.title: Frontend entry and bootstrap
tour.description: Start from the Vite entry point and see how the app is bootstrapped.

tour.title: Routing and feature composition
tour.description: Follow how routes are composed from feature-level routers into the app router.

tour.title: Student profile and resume builder UI
tour.description: Understand the profile page, resume builder, and how they call profile and resume APIs.

tour.title: Matching flow UI
tour.description: See how matching requests are assembled from profile data and sent to the backend.

tour.title: Career path exploration
tour.description: Follow the career path page and its API accessors for graph and job profile data.

tour.title: Career report experience
tour.description: Trace how report generation and polishing are coordinated from the report page.

tour.title: Backend entry and app assembly
tour.description: Locate how the Express app is created and configured.

tour.title: Backend module pattern
tour.description: Review the route → schemas → service → repository layering in a representative module.

tour.title: Matching service internals
tour.description: Explore scoring, evidence, and repository integration for matching logic.

tour.title: AI runtime and Pi tools
tour.description: See how AI sessions and Pi tools power profile parsing, report generation, and resume output.

tour.title: Data access and graph storage
tour.description: Identify how Postgres and Neo4j are wired for data and graph operations.

tour.title: Contracts-first API definitions
tour.description: Locate the OpenAPI spec and shared types that drive frontend-backend alignment.

tour.title: Infrastructure and automation
tour.description: Review Docker orchestration and the scripts that prepare data or run services.

tour.title: Architecture and project docs
tour.description: Align the tour with the project documentation and collaboration rules.
